answer: Proof of Stake functions as a mechanism to resist Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit capital rather than compute. Like a solitary island of verified equity, the protocol ensures that creating a mirror network of fake identities incurs prohibitive costs, as each node must stake tokens to participate in consensus. The capital requirement acts as a shifting dune of economic friction; an attacker faces bankruptcy if they attempt to scale identity fraud, as the cost of acquiring stake outweighs any potential profit.
